paras: Application: Nissan/Infiniti VQ35HR and VQ37VHR engines with Radium 20-0458 fuel rails Part Type: Fuel pulse damper adapter, 8AN ORB, 27mm bore (pair) Part Number: 20-0459

The Radium 20-0459 adapters allow the OEM VQ35HR and VQ37VHR fuel pulse dampers to be reused on the Radium 20-0458 Nissan VQ fuel rails. One adapter is used per damper, and the adapters can only be installed in specific rail positions that have adequate clearance – refer to Radium's fitment chart in the installation instructions.
hl: Reuse OEM Dampers: Mounts the OEM VQ35HR/VQ37VHR fuel pulse dampers to the Radium rails
8AN ORB Base: Threads into the 8AN ORB rail ports
Pair: Two adapters with stainless retaining rings
2 x 8AN ORB to Nissan FPD adapters
ft: Radium Engineering FPD Adapter 8AN ORB / 27mm Bore for Nissan 350Z 07-09/370Z/Skyline V36/Infiniti G35/G36 V36 VQ35HR/VQ37VHR
